title: Moraine Lake & Lake Louise Private Day Tour with Banff Explorer
includes: English speaking travel guide and driver
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
The hours specified in the tour are the hours taken on the journey and these are approximate only.
Travel time is Included in the Total Tour Duration
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a private sightseeing tour from Calgary, Canmore or Banff to explore the stunning Banff National Park, Lake Louise, and Moraine Lake. This exclusive, customizable tour lets you discover the breathtaking beauty of the Canadian Rockies at your own pace. 

Start at Lake Louise, famous for its turquoise waters framed by towering peaks, then head to Moraine Lake, one of the most photographed spots in the world, with its vibrant blue waters and dramatic backdrop. Perfect for nature lovers, photographers, and adventure seekers, this private tour offers a personalized experience, allowing you to enjoy the sights, capture photos, and learn about the area’s history and wildlife. 

Whether you're a solo traveller, a couple, or part of a small group, enjoy the comfort and flexibility of a private vehicle. 

Book today for an unforgettable journey through the heart of the Canadian Rockies, where nature’s beauty comes alive!
